criteria.requirement: Give a workable existing-API configuration/reuse plan, fresh per-document state and meaningful output validation. Do not promise arbitrary custom plugin thread safety or byte-perfect Markdown rewriting, and do not introduce an unnecessary service or parser API.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
